items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I remember playing, walking to the cemetery with him. But, oh, Dick, I played so many things... I don't remember too much about him.

ctx.x: It's working now. Let's get your name first. Yours is turning. Yours is turning?
Okay, it's turning. Okay. Dick Allen, my name is Harold Peterson.
